title: Jaguars are bringing a healthy long snapper to London for Week 6

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jaguars are bringing a healthy long snapper to London for Week 6
sources.description: Thanks in part to a helping hand from Eagles head coach Nick Sirianni, the Jaguars survived the loss of long snapper Ross Matiscik in Sunday's win but they aren't going to risk having to scramble again in Week 6.
